# Wisdom of Solomon Chapter 9 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Wisdom 9 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/WIS_009_page_001.jpg

---

**9:1** God of our ancestors, Lord of all mercy — you who made everything that exists by your word alone,

**9:2** who shaped the human race by your Wisdom and gave us dominion over the creatures you called into being,

**9:3** so that we might govern the world in holiness and justice, and render verdicts with a straight and upright heart —

**9:4** give me the Wisdom who takes her seat at your side, and do not pass me over as unworthy among your children.

**9:5** For I am your servant, the son of your own handmaid — a frail and short-lived man, far too limited in my grasp of justice and what the law requires.

**9:6** Even if someone were to be the most perfect of all human beings, without your Wisdom he would count for nothing.

**9:7** You chose me to be king over your own people, to be the judge of your sons and daughters.

**9:8** You commanded me to build a temple on your holy mountain, and an altar in the city where you have made your dwelling — a copy of the sacred tent you had already prepared before the world began.

**9:9** Wisdom is with you — she who knows your works, who stood beside you when you were making the world, who knows exactly what pleases you and what accords with your commands.

**9:10** Send her down from your holy heavens; release her from your glorious throne. Let her come and work alongside me, so I can learn what is pleasing to you.

**9:11** She knows and understands everything. She will lead my steps with good judgment and guard me with her splendor.

**9:12** Then everything I do will be acceptable; I will govern your people with justice, and I will be worthy to sit on my father's throne.

**9:13** For what mortal can ever know the mind of God? Who can figure out what the Lord intends?

**9:14** Our thoughts are hesitant and uncertain; our plans are unreliable.

**9:15** This perishable body drags the soul down, and the clay tent of flesh weighs on a mind already full of worries.

**9:16** We can barely work out what goes on here on earth — even what is right in front of us takes hard effort to discover. So who could ever trace the pathways of heaven?

**9:17** And who would have known your will at all, unless you yourself had given Wisdom and sent your holy Spirit down from above?

**9:18** That is how the paths of those on earth were set right. That is how people came to know what pleases you. That is how, through Wisdom, they were saved.
